title: Unregister and doctor legacy-record wording, scope and tests (WCLI-125 opus follow-up)
description: Follow-up from the opus APPROVE at 9ee8b83 of ward-cli#254 (WCLI-125), findings N1 to N6 and the item-7 stale comments. Each fails closed. N1: the unregister prompt (terminal-consent.ts second question) and result text (unregister.ts) say kept legacy approvals go live on re-registering; they cannot, since a re-registration gets a fresh nonce. N2: unregister removes another project's legacy binding at the same (root, device, inode) without naming it (legacyBindingsAt does not filter on projectId); show it or scope by projectId, with a test. N3: the in-transaction re-check can remove a current binding the user was never shown; refuse or re-prompt if the set changed, and approvalsRemoved must match what was removed. N4: the doctor's legacy remedy (reporting.ts) can be impossible and sits under 'inert and unreachable'; say 'register and approve again' or order it after the binding and manifest arms. N5: tests that cannot go red: the NUL pointer and .git-link guards need separating, the e2e re-clone approval assertions need fixing, and the approve-side legacy test must vary projectId, root and device. Item 7: stale comments at vault-state.ts near 1166-1169 and 84-88 and unregister.ts 4-8. N6: ADR 0026's Status line omits (a7), and the (a7) attribution of the APFS limit in the Consequences must be checked against opum-doc's record, read by ref. Open residual, decided and left: ADR 0005 carries no banner while review.toml includes its decision section.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Unregister's second question and result text no longer say kept legacy approvals go live on re-registering

Unregister names or scopes by projectId every binding it removes, a test covers a legacy binding of another project, and the in-transaction re-check refuses or re-prompts when the removal set changed, with approvalsRemoved matching what was removed
The doctor's legacy remedy says register and approve again, or is ordered after the binding and manifest arms, and a test covers it
Each of the NUL-pointer, .git-link, e2e re-clone and approve-side legacy tests fails when its own guard is removed
The stale comments in vault-state.ts and unregister.ts name the nonce, and ADR 0026's Status line and (a7) attribution agree with opum-doc's record read by ref

implementationNotes: Built on fix/wcli-137-legacy-record-wording. N1: the unregister second question, result text, header comment and ADR 0022 now say re-registering the same clone revives approvals this version wrote and never an earlier version approval (test: the prompt text, and the kept-approvals report). N2 and N3: unregister computes one removal set (removalSet in unregister.ts): the matched binding plus legacy bindings of the SAME project at this directory and the approvals belonging to them; a legacy binding of another project is neither shown, counted nor removed (test: another-project legacy binding and approval stay). The in-transaction check compares a fingerprint of every record removed and refuses with project_not_registered (the code a vanished binding already raised) if the set changed, and approvalsRemoved is the count actually removed (test: a binding appearing between the question and the write removes nothing). N4: the doctor legacy remedy now says register and approve again (ward init, then ward profile approve), if the profile is still declared; ordering after the binding arm is impossible because a legacy record never matches a binding, so the wording carries it. N5: the approve-side legacy test now varies projectId, root and device each alone; a CR-in-directory-name pointer case isolates the control-character guard; the e2e re-clone asserts a positive control for the old clone and that the old directory identity with the new nonce inherits no approval (red if the nonce is ignored whatever the inode); the NUL and .git-link cases are stated as outcome tests because realpath and the lstat file check double-guard them and cannot be isolated. Item 7: stale comments fixed in vault-state.ts and unregister.ts. N6: ADR 0026 Status now names (a7), and the APFS attribution was checked against DEC-255 (a7)(5), read by ref from opum-doc origin/dev: it matches. ADR 0026 notes unregister is project-scoped, which narrows (a7)(2)-(4) text, a legacy binding at the same tuple, to the one project shown; the narrowing is the finding N2 remedy and removes nothing beyond what (a7) allows. Mutation controls, each red: dropping the fingerprint comparison, the project filter, the isReplacedBy projectId comparison, the pointer control-character guard. bun run check 1201 pass, lore check, lore validate --strict, check-lore-agent-sources clean.
